coordinates: full-canvas pixels; x right, y down; left/right are viewer-relative

layers.transform: inherit exact head transform; display one variant only

validation.type: static offset composites, not runtime animation

notes: Head contains face, brows, mouth, bangs and front side locks. Eye overlays include a small feathered skin margin.
Rear hair roots overlap head and body; center overlap is hidden behind torso.
Generated body and rear-hair plates restore occluded regions. Visible source colors are retained where feasible.
Runtime loads these layers for Idle and Blink. Click, Drag, Sleep and Wake retain the original whole-sprite states.
